reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East

title.narrative: 2026 oPt Emergency Appeal - Gaza - Emergency Health and Nutrition

description.narrative: The Agency aims to address the primary health care needs of up to 1.6 million people through fixed and mobile health facilities, the provision of essential medicines, maternal and child health care, immunisation, MHPSS, and treatment of communicable and non-communicable diseases. UNRWA will also seek to strengthen the health supply chain, support continuity of care for chronic conditions, expand rehabilitation services for the injured and restore routine reproductive health care. Where access improves, the Agency will assess health installations in newly accessible areas and prioritise repairs to restore safe service delivery. In the context of the enduring risk of famine and persistently high levels of malnutrition, UNRWA will continue nutritional screening for children aged six months to five years, aiming to reach over 180,000 individuals in need. The Agency will also coordinate with partners, including UNICEF and WFP, to provide supplementary food for over 500,000 children and pregnant and nursing women identified as malnourished or at risk thereof, and will continue providing supplementary food items to children attending its temporary learning spaces. These efforts will be linked with food assistance and WASH interventions to address the underlying causes of malnutrition and prevent disease outbreaks.
